## My request for Codex:
请你基于 NuttX 嵌入式 RTOS 系统，在 lvgl_app 项目根目录下生成一套专业可编译、工业级成熟度、模块化可裁剪的 LVGL 应用开发框架。整体参考 X-Track、TouchGFX、AWTK 等成熟嵌入式 GUI 项目架构，严格遵循 NuttX 原生构建体系，核心要求是 Kconfig 实现分级嵌套、层层管理，支持通过 menuconfig 可视化裁剪所有功能模块。先移除/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app路径下的原有框架。然后按照下面的要求重新搭建框架。
请严格按照以下所有要求生成完整目录结构与对应源码文件，所有代码符合 C99 规范，适配 NuttX POSIX 接口与 LVGL v8.x 通用 API：
一、核心设计原则（必须严格遵守）

    分层解耦：采用 MVP 架构，UI 视图层 / 业务服务层 / 数据模型层 / 硬件抽象层完全分离，层间只能通过接口调用
    Kconfig 分级管理：从顶层到子目录实现树形嵌套配置，每个功能模块都有独立配置开关与参数，可通过 menuconfig 逐级展开配置
    静态内存优先：核心框架避免动态内存分配，关键数据结构使用预分配与内存池
    线程安全：LVGL UI 单线程运行，业务服务独立线程，跨线程通信通过事件总线实现，所有共享资源加锁保护
    页面生命周期：所有页面统一基于栈式管理，具备完整的 create/show/hide/destroy 生命周期
    NuttX 原生兼容：完全适配 NuttX 构建系统、POSIX 线程 / 信号量 / 文件系统接口，不引入第三方依赖

二、目录结构与 Kconfig 分级规则
2.1 整体目录层级（必须严格对齐）
plaintext

├── Kconfig                # 顶层总配置（一级菜单）
├── Make.defs              # 编译入口判定
├── Makefile               # 顶层编译规则
├── app_main/              # 应用入口与主任务
│   ├── Kconfig            # 应用基础参数配置

2.2 Kconfig 分级管理硬性要求

    嵌套引用规则：上层目录 Kconfig 通过 source "子目录路径/Kconfig" 引用下层配置，形成完整树形菜单
    命名规范：所有配置项统一前缀 CONFIG_LVGL_APP_，二级模块追加前缀，例如：
        顶层总开关：CONFIG_LVGL_APP
        框架层页面管理器：CONFIG_LVGL_APP_FRAMEWORK_PAGE_MANAGER
        页面 - 主页：CONFIG_LVGL_APP_UI_PAGES_PAGE_HOME
    依赖关系：子模块配置必须依赖父模块开关，父模块关闭时子菜单不可见
    参数可配：关键参数（任务优先级、栈大小、页面栈深度、事件队列长度等）全部通过 Kconfig 配置，代码中通过宏引用
    帮助说明：每个配置项必须带 help 说明，标注用途与默认值建议
    默认值合理：提供默认安全配置，关闭非必要功能，保证最小系统可编译运行

三、核心模块代码实现要求
每个模块必须输出完整的 .h 与 .c 文件，具备可运行的基础实现，禁止空文件：
3.1 框架核心层

    页面管理器：实现栈式导航，支持 push/pop/replace/back_to_root，定义页面基类与四阶段生命周期，支持页面跳转传参
    事件总线：实现发布 - 订阅模式，支持同步 / 异步发布，跨线程安全，事件 ID 枚举化管理，支持取消订阅
    资源管理器：统一管理字体、图片加载，支持按需加载与引用计数
    通用工具：环形缓冲区、内存池、链表、分级日志、软件定时器

3.2 UI 层

    页面基类规范：每个页面独立目录，分离 view 与 presenter，view 层只做控件绘制，不包含业务逻辑
    通用组件：标题栏、状态栏、弹窗、Toast 等可复用组件
    主题系统：统一色板与样式，支持亮 / 暗主题切换

3.3 服务与数据层

    服务管理器：统一管理业务服务的启停、优先级调度
    数据中心：全局数据模型，支持数据变更订阅
    每个服务独立线程：通过 NuttX pthread 创建，配置独立栈大小与优先级

3.4 HAL 与平台层

    显示 / 输入抽象接口：头文件定义统一接口，NuttX 下对接 framebuffer 与 input 子系统
    平台封装：线程、互斥量、信号量、时基的平台适配层，屏蔽系统差异

四、NuttX 构建系统规范

    Make.defs：根据 CONFIG_LVGL_APP 条件性将本目录加入编译链
    Makefile：
        包含 $(APPDIR)/Make.defs 引入 NuttX 编译环境
        通过 Kconfig 宏条件性添加源文件到 CSRCS
        使用 VPATH 处理多级子目录
        最终包含 $(APPDIR)/Application.mk
    所有源文件按需编译：对应模块 Kconfig 关闭时，对应源文件不加入编译，确保固件体积最小化

五、输出格式要求

    按目录层级逐个文件输出，每个文件前标注完整相对路径，例如 [lvgl_app/Kconfig]
    代码注释清晰，关键逻辑与接口处添加功能说明
    优先输出 Kconfig 体系与构建文件，再输出核心框架代码，最后输出示例页面与服务
    所有代码必须语法正确，可直接放入 NuttX 外部应用目录参与编译，无明显语法错误
    最后补充一段集成说明：如何将本 lvgl_app 目录集成到 NuttX 源码树中、如何配置 menuconfig、如何编译运行
我会先看现有 `app/lvgl_app` 和 NuttX 应用目录的构建/Kconfig 接入方式，再删除并重建框架，避免生成出来的目录和当前工程约定不匹配。

ifneq ($(MAINSRC),)
  ifeq ($(DYNLIB),y)
    BUILD_MODULE = y

  else ifneq ($(or $(filter y,$(CONFIG_BUILD_KERNEL)), $(filter m,$(MODULE))),)

# The GNU make CURDIR will always be a POSIX-like path with forward slashes
# as path segment separators.  If we know that this is a native build, then
# we need to fix up the path so the DELIM will match the actual delimiter.

ifeq ($(CONFIG_WINDOWS_NATIVE),y)
  CWD = $(strip ${shell echo %CD% | cut -d: -f2})
else
  CWD = $(CURDIR)
endif

SUFFIX ?= $(subst $(DELIM),.,$(CWD))

PROGNAME := $(subst ",,$(PROGNAME))

# When building a module, link with the necessary libraries
# 1. system libraries such as proxies,c,mm
# 2. application libraries such as libapps, custom BIN in apps/staging
# 3. extra libraries such as compiler-rt lib, extra external libs
ifeq ($(BUILD_MODULE),y)
  LDLIBS += $(call CONVERT_PATH,$(APPDIR)$(DELIM)libapps$(LIBEXT))
  $(foreach lib,$(notdir $(wildcard $(APPDIR)$(DELIM)staging$(DELIM)*$(LIBEXT))), \
  $(foreach elib,$(EXTRA_LIBS), \
    $(if $(filter $(notdir $(elib)),$(lib)), \
      $(eval NAMEFULL_LIBS+=$(elib)), \
      $(if $(filter $(notdir $(elib)),$(patsubst lib%$(LIBEXT),-l%,$(lib))), \
        $(eval NAMESPEC_LIBS+=$(elib)) \
       ) \
     ) \
   ) \
 )
  LDLIBS += $(filter-out $(NAMEFULL_LIBS) $(NAMESPEC_LIBS),$(EXTRA_LIBS))
  LDLIBS += $(wildcard $(APPDIR)$(DELIM)staging$(DELIM)*$(LIBEXT))
endif

# Apps compilation can achieve out-of-tree intermediate products
# by specifying "PREFIX" to a directory in its own Makefile.
# Default value is NULL,
# Make sure the out-of-tree directory exists and ends with $(DELIM) when setting it.

PREFIX ?=

RASRCS = $(filter %.s,$(ASRCS))
CASRCS = $(filter %.S,$(ASRCS))

RAOBJS = $(RASRCS:%=$(PREFIX)%$(SUFFIX)$(OBJEXT))
CAOBJS = $(CASRCS:%=$(PREFIX)%$(SUFFIX)$(OBJEXT))
COBJS = $(CSRCS:%=$(PREFIX)%$(SUFFIX)$(OBJEXT))
CXXOBJS = $(CXXSRCS:%=$(PREFIX)%$(SUFFIX)$(OBJEXT))
RUSTOBJS = $(RUSTSRCS:%=$(PREFIX)%$(SUFFIX)$(OBJEXT))
ZIGOBJS = $(ZIGSRCS:%=$(PREFIX)%$(SUFFIX)$(OBJEXT))
DOBJS = $(DSRCS:%=$(PREFIX)%$(SUFFIX)$(OBJEXT))
SWIFTOBJS = $(SWIFTSRCS:%=$(PREFIX)%$(SUFFIX)$(OBJEXT))
AIDLOBJS = $(patsubst %$(AIDLEXT),%$(CXXEXT),$(AIDLSRCS))

MAINCXXSRCS = $(filter %$(CXXEXT),$(MAINSRC))
MAINCSRCS = $(filter %.c,$(MAINSRC))
MAINRUSTSRCS = $(filter %$(RUSTEXT),$(MAINSRC))
MAINZIGSRCS = $(filter %$(ZIGEXT),$(MAINSRC))
MAINDSRCS = $(filter %$(DEXT),$(MAINSRC))
MAINSWIFTSRCS = $(filter %$(SWIFTEXT),$(MAINSRC))
MAINCXXOBJ = $(MAINCXXSRCS:%=$(PREFIX)%$(SUFFIX)$(OBJEXT))
MAINCOBJ = $(MAINCSRCS:%=$(PREFIX)%$(SUFFIX)$(OBJEXT))
MAINRUSTOBJ = $(MAINRUSTSRCS:%=$(PREFIX)%$(SUFFIX)$(OBJEXT))
MAINZIGOBJ = $(MAINZIGSRCS:%=$(PREFIX)%$(SUFFIX)$(OBJEXT))
MAINDOBJ = $(MAINDSRCS:%=$(PREFIX)%$(SUFFIX)$(OBJEXT))
MAINSWIFTOBJ = $(MAINSWIFTSRCS:%=$(PREFIX)%$(SUFFIX)$(OBJEXT))

SRCS = $(ASRCS) $(CSRCS) $(CXXSRCS) $(MAINSRC)
OBJS = $(RAOBJS) $(CAOBJS) $(COBJS) $(CXXOBJS) $(RUSTOBJS) $(ZIGOBJS) $(DOBJS) $(SWIFTOBJS) $(EXTOBJS)

  NLIST := $(shell seq 1 $(words $(PROGNAME)))
  $(foreach i, $(NLIST), \
    $(eval PROGNAME_$(word $i,$(PROGOBJ)) := $(word $i,$(PROGNAME))) \
    $(eval PROGOBJ_$(word $i,$(PROGLIST)) := $(word $i,$(PROGOBJ))) \
    $(eval PRIORITY_$(word $i,$(REGLIST)) := \
        $(if $(word $i,$(PRIORITY)),$(word $i,$(PRIORITY)),$(lastword $(PRIORITY)))) \
    $(eval STACKSIZE_$(word $i,$(REGLIST)) := \
        $(if $(word $i,$(STACKSIZE)),$(word $i,$(STACKSIZE)),$(lastword $(STACKSIZE)))) \
    $(eval UID_$(word $i,$(REGLIST)) := \
        $(if $(word $i,$(UID)),$(word $i,$(UID)),$(lastword $(UID)))) \
    $(eval GID_$(word $i,$(REGLIST)) := \
        $(if $(word $i,$(GID)),$(word $i,$(GID)),$(lastword $(GID)))) \
    $(eval MODE_$(word $i,$(REGLIST)) := \
        $(if $(word $i,$(MODE)),$(word $i,$(MODE)),$(lastword $(MODE)))) \
    $(eval HEAPSIZE_$(word $i,$(REGLIST)) := \
        $(if $(word $i,$(HEAPSIZE)),$(word $i,$(HEAPSIZE)),$(lastword $(HEAPSIZE)))) \

+# LVGL App Framework
+
+This directory is a NuttX external application that provides a modular LVGL
+application framework. It follows the native NuttX application build flow:
+
+- `Kconfig` exposes the top-level `LVGL_APP` menu and sources every child
+  module menu.
+- `Make.defs` adds this directory to `CONFIGURED_APPS` when `LVGL_APP=y`.
+- `Makefile` includes `$(APPDIR)/Make.defs`, conditionally adds sources from
+  enabled Kconfig modules, and finishes with `$(APPDIR)/Application.mk`.
+
+## Integration
+
+1. Source the framework Kconfig from the board/application Kconfig tree:
+
+   ```none
+   source "$APPSDIR/../contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/Kconfig"
+   ```
+
+2. Ensure the directory is reachable from the NuttX apps build. The generated
+   `Make.defs` uses:
+
+   ```make
+   CONFIGURED_APPS += $(APPDIR)/../contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app
+   ```
+
+3. Enable these base options in `menuconfig`:
+
+   ```none
+   Graphics Support -> LVGL graphics library
+   LVGL configuration -> NuttX integration
+   Application Configuration -> LVGL industrial application framework
+   ```
+
+4. Keep optional modules disabled unless needed. The default configuration
+   enables the framework core, event bus, page manager, resource manager,
+   light theme, home page, data service, system information service, HAL
+   stubs, and platform wrappers.
+
+5. Build normally from the NuttX top directory:
+
+   ```sh
+   make menuconfig
+   make -j
+   ```
+
+The command registered by the application is `lvgl_app`. If autostart is
+enabled by Kconfig, the built-in registry starts it using the configured
+priority and stack size.
*** End Patch

from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
root = Path('/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/tupian')
files = sorted(root.glob('*.png'))
thumb_w, thumb_h = 260, 170
label_h = 44
cols = 4
rows = (len(files) + cols - 1) // cols
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (cols * thumb_w, rows * (thumb_h + label_h)), 'white')
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
try:
    font = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 16)
except Exception:
    font = None
for idx, f in enumerate(files):
    im = Image.open(f).convert('RGB')
    im.thumbnail((thumb_w, thumb_h))
    x = (idx % cols) * thumb_w + (thumb_w - im.width) // 2
    y = (idx // cols) * (thumb_h + label_h) + (thumb_h - im.height) // 2
    sheet.paste(im, (x, y))
    tx = (idx % cols) * thumb_w + 6
    ty = (idx // cols) * (thumb_h + label_h) + thumb_h + 4
    draw.text((tx, ty), f.name, fill=(0,0,0), font=font)
out = Path('/tmp/tupian_contact_sheet.png')
sheet.save(out)
print(out)
PY

from pathlib import Path

base = Path('contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/assets/images')
out_root = base / 'runtime'

    ('widgets/icon_sd_card.png', 'icon_sd_card_overlay.png'),
    ('widgets/icon_speaker.png', 'icon_speaker_overlay.png'),
]

def alpha_for_pixel(r, g, b):
    # The component source images use a baked white/checkerboard canvas.
    # Treat near-white pixels as transparent while preserving cyan/yellow glow.
    whiteness = min(r, g, b)
    maxc = max(r, g, b)
    if whiteness >= 248 and maxc >= 248:
        return 0
    if whiteness >= 238 and maxc >= 242:
        return int(max(0, min(255, (248 - whiteness) * 18)))
    return 255

for rel, out_name in items:
    img = Image.open(base / rel).convert('RGBA')
    pix = img.load()
    w, h = img.size
    left, top, right, bottom = w, h, -1, -1
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            r, g, b, a = pix[x, y]
            na = min(a, alpha_for_pixel(r, g, b))
            pix[x, y] = (r, g, b, na)
            if na > 8:
                if x < left: left = x
                if y < top: top = y
                if x > right: right = x
                if y > bottom: bottom = y
    if right >= left and bottom >= top:
        pad = 4
        left = max(0, left - pad)
        top = max(0, top - pad)
        right = min(w - 1, right + pad)
        bottom = min(h - 1, bottom + pad)
        img = img.crop((left, top, right + 1, bottom + 1))
    img.save(out_root / out_name)
    print(out_name, img.size)

from pathlib import Path
from collections import deque
from PIL import Image

base = Path('contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/assets/images')
out_root = base / 'runtime'
out_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

items = [
    ('panels/dashboard_content_panel.png', 'dashboard_content_panel_overlay.png'),
    ('panels/trend_framerate_panel.png', 'trend_framerate_panel_overlay.png'),

    ('widgets/card_temperature_trend.png', 'card_temperature_trend_overlay.png'),
    ('widgets/gauge_cpu_usage.png', 'gauge_cpu_usage_overlay.png'),
    ('widgets/gauge_display_screen.png', 'gauge_display_screen_overlay.png'),
    ('widgets/gauge_framerate_60fps.png', 'gauge_framerate_60fps_overlay.png'),
    ('widgets/button_sdi_settings.png', 'button_sdi_settings_overlay.png'),
    ('widgets/icon_bluetooth.png', 'icon_bluetooth_overlay.png'),
    ('widgets/icon_sd_card.png', 'icon_sd_card_overlay.png'),
    ('widgets/icon_speaker.png', 'icon_speaker_overlay.png'),
]

def bg_like(r, g, b):
    maxc = max(r, g, b)
    minc = min(r, g, b)
    sat = maxc - minc
    if minc >= 232:
        return True
    if maxc >= 168 and sat <= 42:
        return True
    return False

for rel, out_name in items:
    img = Image.open(base / rel).convert('RGBA')
    pix = img.load()
    w, h = img.size
    seen = bytearray(w * h)
    q = deque()

    def push(x, y):
        i = y * w + x
        if seen[i]:
            return
        r, g, b, a = pix[x, y]
        if a != 0 and bg_like(r, g, b):
            seen[i] = 1
            q.append((x, y))

    for x in range(w):
        push(x, 0)
        push(x, h - 1)
    for y in range(h):
        push(0, y)
        push(w - 1, y)

    while q:
        x, y = q.popleft()
        for nx, ny in ((x - 1, y), (x + 1, y), (x, y - 1), (x, y + 1)):
            if 0 <= nx < w and 0 <= ny < h:
                push(nx, ny)

    left, top, right, bottom = w, h, -1, -1
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            i = y * w + x
            r, g, b, a = pix[x, y]
            if seen[i]:
                pix[x, y] = (r, g, b, 0)
                continue
            if a > 8:
                if x < left: left = x
                if y < top: top = y
                if x > right: right = x
                if y > bottom: bottom = y

    if right >= left and bottom >= top:
        pad = 6
        left = max(0, left - pad)
        top = max(0, top - pad)
        right = min(w - 1, right + pad)
        bottom = min(h - 1, bottom + pad)
        img = img.crop((left, top, right + 1, bottom + 1))

    img.save(out_root / out_name)
    print(out_name, img.size)

#!/bin/bash

CUR_DIR=$(pwd)
SDK_ROOT=$(realpath $CUR_DIR/../..)

# 1. auto infer board name and chip name from .config
# get board name from .config (example: d12x_demo68-nor)
BOARD_NAME=$1
if [ -z "$BOARD_NAME" ]; then
    if [ -f $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/.config ]; then
        BOARD_NAME=$(grep CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_CUSTOM_NAME $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/.config | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d '"')
    fi
fi
# get chip name from .config (example: d12x)
CHIP_NAME=$2
if [ -z "$CHIP_NAME" ]; then
    if [ -f $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/.config ]; then
        if grep -q "CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_D12X=y" $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/.config; then
            CHIP_NAME="d12x"
        else
            CHIP_NAME=$(grep -E "CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_[A-Z0-9]+" $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/.config | grep "=y" | head -n 1 | cut -d'_' -f4 | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | cut -d'=' -f1)
        fi
    fi
fi

# 2. default fallback
BOARD_NAME=${BOARD_NAME:-demo68-nor}
CHIP_NAME=${CHIP_NAME:-d13x}

echo ">>> Packing for Board: $BOARD_NAME"

BOARD_DIR=$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/$BOARD_NAME
PRJ_OUT=$(realpath $CUR_DIR/prebuilt)
TOOLDIR=$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/tools/scripts
TOOLCHAIN_DIR=${SDK_ROOT}/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/toolchain/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-
OBJ_COPY=${TOOLCHAIN_DIR}objcopy
ELF_SIZE=${TOOLCHAIN_DIR}size

echo ">>> Starting $CHIP_NAME image packing..."

if [ ! -d "$PRJ_OUT" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$PRJ_OUT"
fi

# 2. sync latest config files and resources from boards directory
if [ -d $BOARD_DIR/pack ]; then
    echo ">>> Syncing board specific pack config from $BOARD_DIR/pack"
    cp -rv $BOARD_DIR/pack/* $PRJ_OUT/
fi

# 3. prepare base files (ELF/Manifest) and convert to nuttx.bin
if [ -f $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/nuttx.elf ]; then
    cp -f $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/nuttx.elf $PRJ_OUT/$CHIP_NAME.elf
    cp -f $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/nuttx.manifest $PRJ_OUT/nuttx.manifest

    # convert latest ELF to nuttx.bin to use in .its
    echo ">>> Generating nuttx.bin from $CHIP_NAME.elf..."
    $OBJ_COPY -S -O binary -R .note -R .note.gnu.build-id -R .comment $PRJ_OUT/$CHIP_NAME.elf $PRJ_OUT/nuttx.bin

    # display ELF size in console
    $ELF_SIZE $PRJ_OUT/$CHIP_NAME.elf
fi
# 4. prepare system partition file list (SDK resource installation)
python3 $TOOLDIR/gen_partition_file_list.py -c $PRJ_OUT/image_cfg.json -o $PRJ_OUT/partition_file_list.h

# 5. prepare file system content (SDK resource installation)
python3 $TOOLDIR/fsinstall.py --sdkout $PRJ_OUT --clean rodata/,data/
if [ -d $SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/$BOARD_NAME/pack/rodata/ ]; then
python3 $TOOLDIR/fsinstall.py --sdkout $PRJ_OUT --src $SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/$BOARD_NAME/pack/rodata/ --dst rodata/
python3 $TOOLDIR/fsinstall.py --sdkout $PRJ_OUT --src $SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/$BOARD_NAME/pack/data/ --dst data/
else
python3 $TOOLDIR/fsinstall.py --sdkout $PRJ_OUT --src $SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack/resources/rodata/ --dst rodata/
python3 $TOOLDIR/fsinstall.py --sdkout $PRJ_OUT --src $SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack/resources/data/ --dst data/
fi
# 6. generate file system image (FATFS and LittleFS)
pushd $PRJ_OUT > /dev/null
python3 $TOOLDIR/makefatfs.py --fullpart --volab default --cluster 8 --sector 512 --tooldir $TOOLDIR --inputdir rodata --outfile $PRJ_OUT/rodata.fatfs
python3 $TOOLDIR/makelittlefs.py --pagesize 256 --blocksize 4096 --tooldir $TOOLDIR --inputdir data/ --outfile $PRJ_OUT/data.lfs
popd > /dev/null

# 7. generate private resources (PBP/Partition combination)
python3 $TOOLDIR/mk_private_resource.py -v -l $PRJ_OUT/pbp_cfg.json,$PRJ_OUT/partition.json -o $PRJ_OUT/pbp_cfg.bin

# 8. generate final .img image from core generation script
# image filename is dynamically generated
IMG_NAME="${BOARD_NAME}_v1.0.0.img"
python3 $TOOLDIR/mk_image.py -v -c $PRJ_OUT/image_cfg.json -d $PRJ_OUT

echo ">>> Image generated successfully at: $PRJ_OUT/$IMG_NAME"

问题定位到了：不是 LVGL/PNG 解码器没启用，而是运行时 PNG 文件不在目标文件系统路径下。之前代码加载的是：

`B:/data/lvgl_app/assets/images/...` -> NuttX 实际路径 `/data/lvgl_app/assets/images/...`

但打包镜像里没有这些文件，所以 LVGL 报 `File open failed`。

我已经修复：

- 图片资源根路径改为只读分区：`B:/rodata/lvgl_app/assets/images`
- 生成了 1024x600 屏幕级轻量 PNG，避免原始 2784x1632 图在板端解码时内存爆掉
- 已把运行必需 PNG 放入板级打包目录：
  `contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/d13x_demo88-nor/pack/rodata/lvgl_app/assets/images/runtime/screen_1024/`
- 代码加载路径已改到这些轻量图
- 增加了图片打开自检日志，后续如果路径不对会打印具体缺哪个文件
- 已重新构建并打包完整镜像：
  `contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack/prebuilt/d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img`

验证已通过：
- `make -C nuttx -j4`
- `./pack.sh d13x_demo88-nor d13x`
- `rodata.fatfs` 中已包含 6 张运行 PNG，资源总大小约 `988K`

注意：必须烧录新的完整 `.img`，只更新 `nuttx.bin` 不够，因为图片在 `rodata` 分区里。烧录后可先在板端确认：

```sh
ls /rodata/lvgl_app/assets/images/runtime/screen_1024
lvgl_app
```

如果还有问题，新日志会出现 `[home_view] image open failed path=...`，可以直接看缺哪个路径。

text: 从 LVGL 源码看，`B:/rodata/...` 最终应该传给 `open()` 的是 `/rodata/...`，这条路径设计本身没错。现在更像是目标板上 `/rodata` 没挂载新镜像，或镜像里文件名/目录没被目标 FATFS 查到。我会给应用加一个更直接的 POSIX 自检：启动时同时 `stat("/rodata")`、`stat("/rodata/lvgl_app")`、`open(真实路径)`，把 errno 打出来。
还有一点：如果你只是更新了 `nuttx.bin`，日志会变成新路径但 rodata 分区仍然是旧的，这正好会出现现在这种现象。为了让板端能自证，我会加更细的错误日志，同时准备一个更保守的短文件名方案，避免 FAT 目录长文件名实现差异。

原因找到了：代码路径本身 `B:/rodata/...` 没拼错，LVGL 会把它解析成 NuttX 真实路径 `/rodata/...`。你日志里的 `res=12` 是 `LV_FS_RES_UNKNOWN`，对应 LVGL POSIX 驱动内部 `open("/rodata/...")` 失败。也就是说失败点不是 PNG 解码，而是板端运行时没有打开到这些文件。常见原因是只更新了 `nuttx.bin`，但没有烧录新的 `rodata.fatfs/.img`，或者 `/rodata` 没挂载/挂载的还是旧分区内容。

我已经把这个设计缺陷修掉了：主页现在优先使用“编译进固件的 1024x600 轻量 PNG”，不再依赖 `/rodata` 文件系统。文件系统路径仍保留为后备诊断。

主要改动：
- 新增内置资源：[app_embedded_images.c](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/assets/app_embedded_images.c:1)
- 新增开关 `CONFIG_LVGL_APP_ASSETS_EMBEDDED_IMAGES=y`，见 [assets/Kconfig](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/assets/Kconfig:19)
- 首页加载图片时优先走 `lvgl_app_embedded_image()`，见 [page_home_view.c](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/ui/pages/page_home/page_home_view.c:159)
- `Makefile` 已把 `app_embedded_images.c` 加入编译，见 [Makefile](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/Makefile:140)

验证已通过：
- `make -C nuttx -j4`
- `./pack.sh d13x_demo88-nor d13x`
- 新 `nuttx.bin`：`2.3M`
- OS 镜像：`2.3M`，仍低于 3M 分区
- 最终镜像：`contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack/prebuilt/d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img`

现在只更新新的 `nuttx.bin` 也应该能显示首页图片；完整烧录新的 `.img` 也可以。再次运行时不应再出现 `[home_view] image open failed ...` 这两条日志，因为首页背景和中心面板已经不走文件系统。

    fi

# get chip name from .config (example: d12x)
CHIP_NAME=$2
if [ -z "$CHIP_NAME" ]; then
    if [ -f $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/.config ]; then

CHIP_NAME=${CHIP_NAME:-d13x}

echo ">>> Packing for Board: $BOARD_NAME"

BOARD_DIR=$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/$BOARD_NAME
PRJ_OUT=$(realpath $CUR_DIR/prebuilt)
TOOLDIR=$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/tools/scripts
TOOLCHAIN_DIR=${SDK_ROOT}/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/toolchain/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-
OBJ_COPY=${TOOLCHAIN_DIR}objcopy
ELF_SIZE=${TOOLCHAIN_DIR}size

echo ">>> Starting $CHIP_NAME image packing..."

if [ ! -d "$PRJ_OUT" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$PRJ_OUT"
fi

# 2. sync latest config files and resources from boards directory
if [ -d $BOARD_DIR/pack ]; then
    echo ">>> Syncing board specific pack config from $BOARD_DIR/pack"
    cp -rv $BOARD_DIR/pack/* $PRJ_OUT/
fi

# 3. prepare base files (ELF/Manifest) and convert to nuttx.bin
if [ -f $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/nuttx.elf ]; then
    cp -f $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/nuttx.elf $PRJ_OUT/$CHIP_NAME.elf
    cp -f $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/nuttx.manifest $PRJ_OUT/nuttx.manifest

    # convert latest ELF to nuttx.bin to use in .its
    echo ">>> Generating nuttx.bin from $CHIP_NAME.elf..."
    $OBJ_COPY -S -O binary -R .note -R .note.gnu.build-id -R .comment $PRJ_OUT/$CHIP_NAME.elf $PRJ_OUT/nuttx.bin

    # display ELF size in console
    $ELF_SIZE $PRJ_OUT/$CHIP_NAME.elf
fi
# 4. prepare system partition file list (SDK resource installation)
python3 $TOOLDIR/gen_partition_file_list.py -c $PRJ_OUT/image_cfg.json -o $PRJ_OUT/partition_file_list.h

# 5. prepare file system content (SDK resource installation)
python3 $TOOLDIR/fsinstall.py --sdkout $PRJ_OUT --clean rodata/,data/
if [ -d $SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/$BOARD_NAME/pack/rodata/ ]; then
python3 $TOOLDIR/fsinstall.py --sdkout $PRJ_OUT --src $SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/$BOARD_NAME/pack/rodata/ --dst rodata/
python3 $TOOLDIR/fsinstall.py --sdkout $PRJ_OUT --src $SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/$BOARD_NAME/pack/data/ --dst data/
else
python3 $TOOLDIR/fsinstall.py --sdkout $PRJ_OUT --src $SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack/resources/rodata/ --dst rodata/
python3 $TOOLDIR/fsinstall.py --sdkout $PRJ_OUT --src $SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack/resources/data/ --dst data/
fi
# 6. generate file system image (FATFS and LittleFS)
pushd $PRJ_OUT > /dev/null
python3 $TOOLDIR/makefatfs.py --fullpart --volab default --cluster 8 --sector 512 --tooldir $TOOLDIR --inputdir rodata --outfile $PRJ_OUT/rodata.fatfs
python3 $TOOLDIR/makelittlefs.py --pagesize 256 --blocksize 4096 --tooldir $TOOLDIR --inputdir data/ --outfile $PRJ_OUT/data.lfs
popd > /dev/null

# 7. generate private resources (PBP/Partition combination)
python3 $TOOLDIR/mk_private_resource.py -v -l $PRJ_OUT/pbp_cfg.json,$PRJ_OUT/partition.json -o $PRJ_OUT/pbp_cfg.bin

# 8. generate final .img image from core generation script
# image filename is dynamically generated
IMG_NAME="${BOARD_NAME}_v1.0.0.img"
python3 $TOOLDIR/mk_image.py -v -c $PRJ_OUT/image_cfg.json -d $PRJ_OUT

echo ">>> Image generated successfully at: $PRJ_OUT/$IMG_NAME"

        data.append(v & 0xFF)

        elif r > 225 and g > 225 and b > 225:
            data[i+3] = max(0, min(a, (255 - m) * 8))
    return Image.frombytes('RGBA', rgba.size, bytes(data))

    crop = crop.resize(size, Image.LANCZOS)
    x,y = pos
    base = bg.crop((x,y,x+size[0],y+size[1]))
    base.alpha_composite(crop)
    # RGB keeps path fallback simple; embedded descriptor is generated from the same pixels.
    base.convert('RGB').save(screen / name)

def rgb565_bytes(img):
    rgb = img.convert('RGB')
    data = bytearray()
    for r, g, b in rgb.getdata():
        v = ((r & 0xF8) << 8) | ((g & 0xFC) << 3) | (b >> 3)
        data.append(v & 0xFF)
        data.append((v >> 8) & 0xFF)
    return data

def rgb565a8_bytes(img):
    rgba = img.convert('RGBA')
    rgb_plane = bytearray()
    alpha_plane = bytearray()
    for r, g, b, a in rgba.getdata():
        v = ((r & 0xF8) << 8) | ((g & 0xFC) << 3) | (b >> 3)
        rgb_plane.append(v & 0xFF)
        rgb_plane.append((v >> 8) & 0xFF)
        alpha_plane.append(a)
    return rgb_plane + alpha_plane

def array_literal(data):
    lines = []
    for i in range(0, len(data), 12):
        chunk = data[i:i + 12]
        lines.append('  ' + ', '.join(f'0x{b:02x}' for b in chunk) + ',')
    return '\n'.join(lines)

from PIL import Image
from pathlib import Path
from collections import deque

ROOT = Path('contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/assets/images/runtime/screen_1024')
ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
WHITE_LIMIT = 238

try:
    RESAMPLE = Image.LANCZOS
except AttributeError:
    RESAMPLE = Image.BICUBIC

def close_to_white(rgb):
    r, g, b = rgb
    return r >= WHITE_LIMIT and g >= WHITE_LIMIT and b >= WHITE_LIMIT

def alpha_crop(src, bbox, out_name, size):
    im = Image.open(src).convert('RGB').crop(bbox)
    w, h = im.size
    pix = im.load()
    bg = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]
    q = deque()

    def seed(x, y):
        if not bg[y][x] and close_to_white(pix[x, y]):
            bg[y][x] = True
            q.append((x, y))

    for x in range(w):
        seed(x, 0)
        seed(x, h - 1)
    for y in range(h):
        seed(0, y)
        seed(w - 1, y)

    while q:
        x, y = q.popleft()
        for nx, ny in ((x + 1, y), (x - 1, y), (x, y + 1), (x, y - 1)):
            if 0 <= nx < w and 0 <= ny < h and not bg[ny][nx] and close_to_white(pix[nx, ny]):
                bg[ny][nx] = True
                q.append((nx, ny))

    rgba = Image.new('RGBA', (w, h))
    out = rgba.load()
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            r, g, b = pix[x, y]
            a = 0 if bg[y][x] else 255
            out[x, y] = (r, g, b, a)

    # Trim any remaining fully transparent border before final sizing.
    box = rgba.getbbox()
    if box is not None:
        rgba = rgba.crop(box)

    rgba = rgba.resize(size, RESAMPLE)
    rgba.save(ROOT / out_name)
    print(f'{out_name}: {size[0]}x{size[1]} from {src} bbox={bbox}')

def rgb_resize(src, out_name, size):
    im = Image.open(src).convert('RGB').resize(size, RESAMPLE)
    im.save(ROOT / out_name)
    print(f'{out_name}: {size[0]}x{size[1]} from {src}')

# Image Assets

Runtime image assets are grouped by purpose:

- `background/`: full-screen or page-level backgrounds.
- `panels/`: composed dashboard panels.
- `widgets/`: reusable visual widgets and cards.
- `runtime/`: cropped RGBA overlays used by the LVGL page.
- `reference/`: design reference images, not intended for runtime loading.

`LVGL_APP_ASSETS_IMAGE_ROOT_PATH`, defaulting to:

from PIL import Image
from pathlib import Path

OUT = Path('contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/assets/app_embedded_images.c')
IMGDIR = Path('contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/assets/images/runtime/screen_1024')

assets = [
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_DASHBOARD_BACKGROUND', 'dashboard_background', 'dashboard_background_1024x600.png', False),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_TREND_FRAMERATE_PANEL', 'trend_framerate_panel', 'trend_framerate_panel_544x139.png', True),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_BUTTON_SDI_SETTINGS', 'button_sdi_settings', 'button_sdi_settings_123x48.png', True),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_CARD_BATTERY_LEVEL', 'card_battery_level', 'card_battery_level_64x32.png', True),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_CARD_CLOCK_TIME', 'card_clock_time', 'card_clock_time_84x30.png', True),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_CARD_MEMORY_USAGE', 'card_memory_usage', 'card_memory_usage_100x54.png', True),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_CARD_MICROPHONE', 'card_microphone', 'card_microphone_123x52.png', True),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_CARD_TEMPERATURE_TREND', 'card_temperature_trend', 'card_temperature_trend_100x50.png', True),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_CARD_WIFI_STATUS', 'card_wifi_status', 'card_wifi_status_123x52.png', True),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_GAUGE_CPU_USAGE', 'gauge_cpu_usage', 'gauge_cpu_usage_86x69.png', True),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_GAUGE_DISPLAY_SCREEN', 'gauge_display_screen', 'gauge_display_screen_64x64.png', True),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_GAUGE_FRAMERATE_60FPS', 'gauge_framerate_60fps', 'gauge_framerate_60fps_116x96.png', True),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_ICON_BLUETOOTH', 'icon_bluetooth', 'icon_bluetooth_24x24.png', True),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_ICON_SD_CARD', 'icon_sd_card', 'icon_sd_card_123x52.png', True),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_ICON_SPEAKER', 'icon_speaker', 'icon_speaker_123x52.png', True),
    ('LVGL_APP_IMAGE_DASHBOARD_LOG_PANEL', 'dashboard_log_panel', 'dashboard_log_panel_187x251.png', True),
]

def rgb565(r, g, b):
    return ((r & 0xf8) << 8) | ((g & 0xfc) << 3) | (b >> 3)

def c_ident(name):
    return 'g_img_' + name

def emit_array(lines, symbol, data):
    lines.append('static const LV_ATTRIBUTE_MEM_ALIGN LV_ATTRIBUTE_LARGE_CONST uint8_t')
    lines.append(f'{symbol}_data[] =')
    lines.append('{')
    for i in range(0, len(data), 12):
        chunk = data[i:i + 12]
        lines.append('  ' + ', '.join(f'0x{b:02x}' for b in chunk) + ',')
    lines.append('};')
    lines.append('')

lines = []
lines.append('#include "assets/app_embedded_images.h"')
lines.append('')
lines.append('#include <stddef.h>')
lines.append('#include <stdint.h>')
lines.append('')
lines.append('#ifndef LV_ATTRIBUTE_MEM_ALIGN')
lines.append('#  define LV_ATTRIBUTE_MEM_ALIGN')
lines.append('#endif')
lines.append('')
lines.append('#ifndef LV_ATTRIBUTE_LARGE_CONST')
lines.append('#  define LV_ATTRIBUTE_LARGE_CONST')
lines.append('#endif')
lines.append('')
lines.append('/* Generated from independent dashboard component images.')
lines.append(' * RGB565A8 data is stored in LVGL native planar order:')
lines.append(' * full RGB565 color plane followed by full A8 alpha plane.')
lines.append(' * The full dashboard reference image and old center composite image')
lines.append(' * are intentionally not registered for rendering. */')
lines.append('')

for enum_name, name, filename, has_alpha in assets:
    path = IMGDIR / filename
    im = Image.open(path)
    if has_alpha:
        im = im.convert('RGBA')
    else:
        im = im.convert('RGB')
    w, h = im.size
    stride = w * 2
    color_plane = bytearray()
    alpha_plane = bytearray()
    if has_alpha:
        for r, g, b, a in im.getdata():
            v = rgb565(r, g, b)
            color_plane.append(v & 0xff)
            color_plane.append((v >> 8) & 0xff)
            alpha_plane.append(a)
        data = color_plane + alpha_plane
        fmt = 'LV_COLOR_FORMAT_RGB565A8'
    else:
        for r, g, b in im.getdata():
            v = rgb565(r, g, b)
            color_plane.append(v & 0xff)
            color_plane.append((v >> 8) & 0xff)
        data = color_plane
        fmt = 'LV_COLOR_FORMAT_RGB565'

    ident = c_ident(name)
    macro = 'IMG_' + name.upper()
    lines.append(f'#define {macro}_W {w}u')
    lines.append(f'#define {macro}_H {h}u')
    lines.append(f'#define {macro}_STRIDE {stride}u')
    lines.append('')
    emit_array(lines, ident, data)
    lines.append(f'static const lv_image_dsc_t {ident} =')
    lines.append('{')
    lines.append('  .header =')
    lines.append('  {')
    lines.append('    .magic = LV_IMAGE_HEADER_MAGIC,')
    lines.append(f'    .cf = {fmt},')
    lines.append('    .flags = 0,')
    lines.append(f'    .w = {macro}_W,')
    lines.append(f'    .h = {macro}_H,')
    lines.append(f'    .stride = {macro}_STRIDE,')
    lines.append('  },')
    lines.append(f'  .data_size = sizeof({ident}_data),')
    lines.append(f'  .data = {ident}_data,')
    lines.append('};')
    lines.append('')

lines.append('const lv_image_dsc_t *lvgl_app_embedded_image(lvgl_app_image_id_t image)')
lines.append('{')
lines.append('  switch (image)')
lines.append('    {')
for enum_name, name, filename, has_alpha in assets:
    lines.append(f'      case {enum_name}:')
    lines.append(f'        return &{c_ident(name)};')
    lines.append('')
lines.append('      default:')
lines.append('        return NULL;')
lines.append('    }')
lines.append('}')

OUT.write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
print(f'generated {OUT} with planar RGB565A8')
PY

原因找到了：不是图片资源没注册，也不是文件路径问题。你当前 LVGL 的 `LV_COLOR_FORMAT_RGB565A8` 要求数据格式是：

`完整 RGB565 颜色平面 + 完整 A8 alpha 平面`

我之前生成的是逐像素交错的 `RGB565 + A`，LVGL 读取 alpha 时会读错，所以组件图会不显示或显示异常。已经修复为 LVGL 原生平面布局，位置和 UI 逻辑没动。

已修改并重编译通过：

- 修复文件：[app_embedded_images.c](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/assets/app_embedded_images.c:1)
- 局部编译通过：`make -C app/lvgl_app ...`
- 完整编译通过：`./autobuild.sh d13x_demo88-nor nsh_lvgl rebuild`
- 新镜像已生成：`/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img`

中文字体这块：你现在配置里没有开 `CONFIG_LV_FONT_SIMSUN_16_CJK`，所以 LVGL 自己画中文 label 会缺字。但这次组件图片里的中文是图片像素，不依赖字体库；图片不显示的主因是 RGB565A8 数据布局错误。

请烧录刚生成的新 `d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img` 再测。运行日志里 `cf=20` 和 bytes 数值大概率还是一样，这是正常的，区别在固件内数组的实际排列方式。

# Image Generation Skill

Generates or edits images for the current project (for example website assets, game assets, UI mockups, product mockups, wireframes, logo design, photorealistic images, or infographics).

## Top-level modes and rules

This skill has exactly two top-level modes:

- **Default built-in tool mode (preferred):** built-in `image_gen` tool for normal image generation, editing, and simple transparent-image requests. Does not require `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
- **Fallback CLI mode:** `scripts/image_gen.py` CLI. Use when the user explicitly asks for the CLI/API/model path, or after the user explicitly confirms a true model-native transparency fallback with `gpt-image-1.5`. Requires `OPENAI_API_KEY`.

Within CLI fallback, the CLI exposes three subcommands:

- `generate`
- `edit`
- `generate-batch`

Rules:
- Use the built-in `image_gen` tool by default for normal image generation and editing requests.
- Do not switch to CLI fallback for ordinary quality, size, or file-path control.
- If the user explicitly asks for a transparent image/background, stay on built-in `image_gen` first: prompt for a flat removable chroma-key background, then remove it locally with the installed helper at `$CODEX_HOME/skills/.system/imagegen/scripts/remove_chroma_key.py`.
- Never silently switch from built-in `image_gen` or CLI `gpt-image-2` to CLI `gpt-image-1.5`. Treat this as a model/path downgrade and ask the user before doing it, unless the user has already explicitly requested `gpt-image-1.5`, `scripts/image_gen.py`, or CLI fallback.
- If a transparent request appears too complex for clean chroma-key removal, asks for true/native transparency, or local removal fails validation, explain that true transparency requires CLI `gpt-image-1.5 --background transparent --output-format png` because `gpt-image-2` does not support `background=transparent`, then ask whether to proceed. Run the CLI fallback only after the user confirms.
- The word `batch` by itself does not mean CLI fallback. If the user asks for many assets or says to batch-generate assets without explicitly asking for CLI/API/model controls, stay on the built-in path and issue one built-in call per requested asset or variant.
- If the built-in tool fails or is unavailable, tell the user the CLI fallback exists and that it requires `OPENAI_API_KEY`. Proceed only if the user explicitly asks for that fallback.
- If the user explicitly asks for CLI mode, use the bundled `scripts/image_gen.py` workflow. Do not create one-off SDK runners.
- Never modify `scripts/image_gen.py`. If something is missing, ask the user before doing anything else.

Built-in save-path policy:
- In built-in tool mode, Codex saves generated images under `$CODEX_HOME/*` by default.
- Do not describe or rely on OS temp as the default built-in destination.
- Do not describe or rely on a destination-path argument (if any) on the built-in `image_gen` tool. If a specific location is needed, generate first and then move or copy the selected output from `$CODEX_HOME/generated_images/...`.
- Save-path precedence in built-in mode:
  1. If the user names a destination, move or copy the selected output there.
  2. If the image is meant for the current project, move or copy the final selected image into the workspace before finishing.
  3. If the image is only for preview or brainstorming, render it inline; the underlying file can remain at the default `$CODEX_HOME/*` path.
- Never leave a project-referenced asset only at the default `$CODEX_HOME/*` path.
- Do not overwrite an existing asset unless the user explicitly asked for replacement; otherwise create a sibling versioned filename such as `hero-v2.png` or `item-icon-edited.png`.

Shared prompt guidance for both modes lives in `references/prompting.md` and `references/sample-prompts.md`.

Fallback-only docs/resources for CLI mode:
- `references/cli.md`
- `references/image-api.md`
- `references/codex-network.md`
- `scripts/image_gen.py`

Local post-processing helper:
- `$CODEX_HOME/skills/.system/imagegen/scripts/remove_chroma_key.py`: removes a flat chroma-key background from a generated image and writes a PNG/WebP with alpha. Prefer auto-key sampling, soft matte, and despill for antialiased edges.

## When to use
- Generate a new image (concept art, product shot, cover, website hero)
- Generate a new image using one or more reference images for style, composition, or mood
- Edit an existing image (inpainting, lighting or weather transformations, background replacement, object removal, compositing, transparent background)
- Produce many assets or variants for one task

## When not to use
- Extending or matching an existing SVG/vector icon set, logo system, or illustration library inside the repo
- Creating simple shapes, diagrams, wireframes, or icons that are better produced directly in SVG, HTML/CSS, or canvas
- Making a small project-local asset edit when the source file already exists in an editable native format
- Any task where the user clearly wants deterministic code-native output instead of a generated bitmap

## Decision tree

Think about two separate questions:

1. **Intent:** is this a new image or an edit of an existing image?
2. **Execution strategy:** is this one asset or many assets/variants?

Intent:
- If the user wants to modify an existing image while preserving parts of it, treat the request as **edit**.
- If the user provides images only as references for style, composition, mood, or subject guidance, treat the request as **generate**.
- If the user provides no images, treat the request as **generate**.

Built-in edit semantics:
- Built-in edit mode is for images already visible in the conversation context, such as attached images or images generated earlier in the thread.
- If the user wants to edit a local image file with the built-in tool, first load it with built-in `view_image` tool so the image is visible in the conversation context, then proceed with the built-in edit flow.
- Do not promise arbitrary filesystem-path editing through the built-in tool.
- If a local file still needs direct file-path control, masks, or other explicit CLI-only parameters, use the explicit CLI fallback only when the user asks for it.
- For edits, preserve invariants aggressively and save non-destructively by default.

Execution strategy:
- In the built-in default path, produce many assets or variants by issuing one `image_gen` call per requested asset or variant.
- In the CLI fallback path, use the CLI `generate-batch` subcommand only when the user explicitly chose CLI mode and needs many prompts/assets.
- For many distinct assets, do not use `n` as a substitute for separate prompts. `n` is for variants of one prompt; distinct assets need distinct built-in calls or distinct CLI `generate-batch` jobs.

Assume the user wants a new image unless they clearly ask to change an existing one.

## Workflow
1. Decide the top-level mode: built-in by default, including simple transparent-output requests; fallback CLI only if explicitly requested or after the user explicitly confirms a transparent-output fallback.
2. Decide the intent: `generate` or `edit`.
3. Decide whether the output is preview-only or meant to be consumed by the current project.
4. Decide the execution strategy: single asset vs repeated built-in calls vs CLI `generate-batch`.
5. Collect inputs up front: prompt(s), exact text (verbatim), constraints/avoid list, and any input images.
6. For every input image, label its role explicitly:
   - reference image
   - edit target
   - supporting insert/style/compositing input
7. If the edit target is only on the local filesystem and you are staying on the built-in path, inspect it with `view_image` first so the image is available in conversation context.
8. If the user asked for a photo, illustration, sprite, product image, banner, or other explicitly raster-style asset, use `image_gen` rather than substituting SVG/HTML/CSS placeholders. If the request is for an icon, logo, or UI graphic that should match existing repo-native SVG/vector/code assets, prefer editing those directly instead.
9. Augment the prompt based on specificity:
   - If the user's prompt is already specific and detailed, normalize it into a clear spec without adding creative requirements.
   - If the user's prompt is generic, add tasteful augmentation only when it materially improves output quality.
10. Use the built-in `image_gen` tool by default.
11. For transparent-output requests, follow the transparent image guidance below: generate with built-in `image_gen` on a flat chroma-key background, copy the selected output into the workspace or `tmp/imagegen/`, run the installed `$CODEX_HOME/skills/.system/imagegen/scripts/remove_chroma_key.py` helper, and validate the alpha result before using it. If this path looks unsuitable or fails, ask before switching to CLI `gpt-image-1.5`.
12. Inspect outputs and validate: subject, style, composition, text accuracy, and invariants/avoid items.
13. Iterate with a single targeted change, then re-check.
14. For preview-only work, render the image inline; the underlying file may remain at the default `$CODEX_HOME/generated_images/...` path.
15. For project-bound work, move or copy the selected artifact into the workspace and update any consuming code or references. Never leave a project-referenced asset only at the default `$CODEX_HOME/generated_images/...` path.
16. For batches or multi-asset requests, persist every requested deliverable final in the workspace unless the user explicitly asked to keep outputs preview-only. Discarded variants do not need to be kept unless requested.
17. If the user explicitly chooses or confirms the CLI fallback, then use the fallback-only docs for model, quality, size, `input_fidelity`, masks, output format, output paths, and network setup.
18. Always report the final saved path(s) for any workspace-bound asset(s), plus the final prompt or prompt set and whether the built-in tool or fallback CLI mode was used.

## Transparent image requests

Transparent-image requests still use built-in `image_gen` first. Because the built-in tool does not expose a true transparent-background control, create a removable chroma-key source image and then convert the key color to alpha locally.

Default sequence:
1. Use built-in `image_gen` to generate the requested subject on a perfectly flat solid chroma-key background.
2. Choose a key color that is unlikely to appear in the subject: default `#00ff00`, use `#ff00ff` for green subjects, and avoid `#0000ff` for blue subjects.
3. After generation, move or copy the selected source image from `$CODEX_HOME/generated_images/...` into the workspace or `tmp/imagegen/`.
4. Run the installed helper path, not a project-relative script path:
   ```bash
   python "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/.system/imagegen/scripts/remove_chroma_key.py" \
     --input <source> \
     --out <final.png> \
     --auto-key border \
     --soft-matte \
     --transparent-threshold 12 \
     --opaque-threshold 220 \
     --despill
   ```
5. Validate that the output has an alpha channel, transparent corners, plausible subject coverage, and no obvious key-color fringe. If a thin fringe remains, retry once with `--edge-contract 1`; use `--edge-feather 0.25` only when the edge is visibly stair-stepped and the subject is not shiny or reflective.
6. Save the final alpha PNG/WebP in the project if the asset is project-bound. Never leave a project-referenced transparent asset only under `$CODEX_HOME/*`.

Prompt transparent requests like this:

```text
Create the requested subject on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal.
The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation.
Keep the subject fully separated from the background with crisp edges and generous padding.
Do not use #00ff00 anywhere in the subject.
No cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no watermark, and no text unless explicitly requested.
```

Do not automatically use CLI `gpt-image-1.5 --background transparent --output-format png` instead of chroma keying. Ask the user first when the user asks for true/native transparency, when local removal fails validation, or when the requested image is complex: hair, fur, feathers, smoke, glass, liquids, translucent materials, reflective objects, soft shadows, realistic product grounding, or subject colors that conflict with all practical key colors.

Use a concise confirmation like:

```text
This likely needs true native transparency. The default built-in path uses a chroma-key background plus local removal, but true transparency requires the CLI fallback with gpt-image-1.5 because gpt-image-2 does not support background=transparent. It also requires OPENAI_API_KEY. Should I proceed with that CLI fallback?
```

## Prompt augmentation

Reformat user prompts into a structured, production-oriented spec. Make the user's goal clearer and more actionable, but do not blindly add detail.

Treat this as prompt-shaping guidance, not a closed schema. Use only the lines that help, and add a short extra labeled line when it materially improves clarity.

### Specificity policy

Use the user's prompt specificity to decide how much augmentation is appropriate:

- If the prompt is already specific and detailed, preserve that specificity and only normalize/structure it.
- If the prompt is generic, you may add tasteful augmentation when it will materially improve the result.

Allowed augmentations:
- composition or framing hints
- polish level or intended-use hints
- practical layout guidance
- reasonable scene concreteness that supports the stated request

Not allowed augmentations:
- extra characters or objects that are not implied by the request
- brand names, slogans, palettes, or narrative beats that are not implied
- arbitrary side-specific placement unless the surrounding layout supports it

## Use-case taxonomy (exact slugs)

Classify each request into one of these buckets and keep the slug consistent across prompts and references.

Generate:
- photorealistic-natural — candid/editorial lifestyle scenes with real texture and natural lighting.
- product-mockup — product/packaging shots, catalog imagery, merch concepts.
- ui-mockup — app/web interface mockups and wireframes; specify the desired fidelity.
- infographic-diagram — diagrams/infographics with structured layout and text.
- scientific-educational — classroom explainers, scientific diagrams, and learning visuals with required labels and accuracy constraints.
- ads-marketing — campaign concepts and ad creatives with audience, brand position, scene, and exact tagline/copy.
- productivity-visual — slide, chart, workflow, and data-heavy business visuals.
- logo-brand — logo/mark exploration, vector-friendly.
- illustration-story — comics, children’s book art, narrative scenes.
- stylized-concept — style-driven concept art, 3D/stylized renders.
- historical-scene — period-accurate/world-knowledge scenes.

Edit:
- text-localization — translate/replace in-image text, preserve layout.
- identity-preserve — try-on, person-in-scene; lock face/body/pose.
- precise-object-edit — remove/replace a specific element (including interior swaps).
- lighting-weather — time-of-day/season/atmosphere changes only.
- background-extraction — transparent background / clean cutout. Use built-in `image_gen` with chroma-key removal first for simple opaque subjects; ask before using CLI true transparency for complex subjects.
- style-transfer — apply reference style while changing subject/scene.
- compositing — multi-image insert/merge with matched lighting/perspective.
- sketch-to-render — drawing/line art to photoreal render.

## Shared prompt schema

Use the following labeled spec as shared prompt scaffolding for both top-level modes:

```text
Use case: <taxonomy slug>
Asset type: <where the asset will be used>
Primary request: <user's main prompt>
Input images: <Image 1: role; Image 2: role> (optional)
Scene/backdrop: <environment>
Subject: <main subject>
Style/medium: <photo/illustration/3D/etc>
Composition/framing: <wide/close/top-down; placement>
Lighting/mood: <lighting + mood>
Color palette: <palette notes>
Materials/textures: <surface details>
Text (verbatim): "<exact text>"
Constraints: <must keep/must avoid>
Avoid: <negative constraints>
```

Notes:
- `Asset type` and `Input images` are prompt scaffolding, not dedicated CLI flags.
- `Scene/backdrop` refers to the visual setting. It is not the same as the fallback CLI `background` parameter, which controls output transparency behavior.
- Fallback-only execution notes such as `Quality:`, `Input fidelity:`, masks, output format, and output paths belong in the CLI path only. Do not treat them as built-in `image_gen` tool arguments.

Augmentation rules:
- Keep it short.
- Add only the details needed to improve the prompt materially.
- For edits, explicitly list invariants (`change only X; keep Y unchanged`).
- If any critical detail is missing and blocks success, ask a question; otherwise proceed.

from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from collections import deque

root = Path('contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/assets/images')
out = root / 'runtime/screen_1024'
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for p in out.glob('*.png'):
    p.unlink()

ref = Image.open(root / 'reference/dashboard_full_effect.png').convert('RGBA')
bg_src = Image.open(root / 'background/dashboard_background.png').convert('RGB')

# Output images are intentionally at final 1024x600 target sizes. LVGL draws
# the primary dashboard at zoom=256 to avoid board-side scaling blur.

def save_resize_from_ref(name, box, size):
    im = ref.crop(box).resize(size, Image.LANCZOS)
    im.save(out / name)
    return out / name

def save_resize_from_file(name, src_rel, box, size, transparent_edges=True):
    im = Image.open(root / src_rel).convert('RGBA')
    im = im.crop(box).resize(size, Image.LANCZOS)
    if transparent_edges:
        im = edge_to_alpha(im)
    im.save(out / name)
    return out / name

def edge_to_alpha(im):
    # Remove only light background connected to image edges. White glyphs inside
    # the component are preserved because they are not edge-connected.
    im = im.convert('RGBA')
    pix = im.load()
    w, h = im.size
    seen = bytearray(w * h)
    q = deque()

    def is_bg(px):
        r, g, b, a = px
        if a == 0:
            return True
        return r >= 215 and g >= 215 and b >= 215

    def push(x, y):
        i = y * w + x
        if seen[i]:
            return
        if is_bg(pix[x, y]):
            seen[i] = 1
            q.append((x, y))

    for x in range(w):
        push(x, 0)
        push(x, h - 1)
    for y in range(h):
        push(0, y)
        push(w - 1, y)

    while q:
        x, y = q.popleft()
        for nx, ny in ((x - 1, y), (x + 1, y), (x, y - 1), (x, y + 1)):

    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if seen[y * w + x]:
                r, g, b, a = pix[x, y]
                # Keep color for antialiasing, remove alpha only.
                pix[x, y] = (r, g, b, 0)
    return im

def rgb565_bytes(im):
    im = im.convert('RGBA')
    w, h = im.size
    color = bytearray()
    alpha = bytearray()
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            r, g, b, a = im.getpixel((x, y))
            v = ((r & 0xf8) << 8) | ((g & 0xfc) << 3) | (b >> 3)
            color.append(v & 0xff)
            color.append((v >> 8) & 0xff)
            alpha.append(a)
    return bytes(color), bytes(alpha)

def bytes_to_c(data, indent='  '):
    lines = []
    for i in range(0, len(data), 12):
        chunk = data[i:i+12]
        lines.append(indent + ', '.join(f'0x{b:02x}' for b in chunk) + ',')
    return '\n'.join(lines)

    f.write(' * The complete dashboard reference image is intentionally not registered. */\n\n')

        else:
            data = color
            cf = 'LV_COLOR_FORMAT_RGB565'

        f.write(f'#define IMG_{macro}_W {w}u\n')
        f.write(f'#define IMG_{macro}_H {h}u\n')
        f.write(f'#define IMG_{macro}_STRIDE {stride}u\n\n')
        f.write('static const LV_ATTRIBUTE_MEM_ALIGN LV_ATTRIBUTE_LARGE_CONST uint8_t\n')
        f.write(f'g_img_{sym}_data[] =\n{{\n')
        f.write(bytes_to_c(data))
        f.write('\n};\n\n')
        f.write(f'static const lv_image_dsc_t g_img_{sym} =\n{{\n')
        f.write('  .header =\n  {\n')
        f.write(f'    .cf = {cf},\n')
        f.write(f'    .w = IMG_{macro}_W,\n')
        f.write(f'    .h = IMG_{macro}_H,\n')
        f.write(f'    .stride = IMG_{macro}_STRIDE,\n')
        f.write('  },\n')
        f.write(f'  .data_size = sizeof(g_img_{sym}_data),\n')
        f.write(f'  .data = g_img_{sym}_data,\n')
        f.write('};\n\n')

    f.write('const lv_image_dsc_t *lvgl_app_embedded_image(lvgl_app_image_id_t image)\n')
    f.write('{\n  switch (image)\n    {\n')
    for enum, sym, filename, has_alpha in entries:
        f.write(f'      case {enum}:\n')
        f.write(f'        return &g_img_{sym};\n')
    for enum in null_enums:
        f.write(f'      case {enum}:\n')
        f.write('        return NULL;\n')
    f.write('      default:\n        return NULL;\n    }\n}\n')

已查到关键问题并修复：不只是 `image_cfg.json` / `partition.json` 要改，运行时代码里还有一份硬编码分区表：

[sfud_cfg.h](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/chips/artinchips/include/drv/inc/sfud_cfg.h:31)

它原来仍是：

```c
3m(os),10m(rodata)
```

这会导致烧录镜像按 `7m/6m` 写入，但 NuttX 启动后 SFUD/MTD 仍按旧 `3m/10m` 注册分区，运行时分区偏移错位。你这个 `Load access fault` 虽然落在 `fdlist_count()`，但这种启动阶段的分区/文件系统错位很容易把系统状态带崩。

我已经统一成：

```text
spi0.0:512k(spl),128k(env),128k(env_r),256k(userid),7m(os),6m(rodata),1m(data)
```

已修改三处：

- [image_cfg.json](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/d13x_demo88-nor/pack/image_cfg.json:9)
- [partition.json](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/d13x_demo88-nor/pack/partition.json:3)
- [sfud_cfg.h](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/chips/artinchips/include/drv/inc/sfud_cfg.h:31)

重新编译已完成，镜像在：

```text
/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img
```

校验结果：

```text
artinchip_os.itb  3.4M  < 7M
rodata.fatfs      1.2M  < 6M
nuttx.elf 内运行时分区字符串已是 7m(os),6m(rodata)
```

这次需要用新生成的完整 `.img` 重新烧录，并且建议执行整包烧录/擦除后烧录。不要只烧 OS 子镜像，因为分区布局已经从旧的 `3m/10m` 改成了 `7m/6m`。

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: nxsched_get_fdlist_from_tcb
 *
 * Description:
 *   Return a pointer to the file descriptor list from task context.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   tcb - Address of the new task's TCB
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   A pointer to the file descriptor list.
 *
 * Assumptions:
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

FAR struct fdlist *nxsched_get_fdlist_from_tcb(FAR struct tcb_s *tcb)
{
  FAR struct task_group_s *group = tcb->group;
  FAR struct fdlist *ret = NULL;

  /* The group may be NULL under certain conditions.  For example, if
   * debug output is attempted from the IDLE thead before the group has
   * been allocated.  I have only seen this case when memory management
   * debug is enabled.
   */

  if (group)
    {
      ret = &group->tg_fdlist;
    }

  /* Higher level logic must handle the NULL gracefully */

  return ret;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: nxsched_get_fdlist
 *
 * Description:
 *   Return a pointer to the file descriptor list for this thread.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   None
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   A pointer to the file descriptor list.
 *
 * Assumptions:
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

FAR struct fdlist *nxsched_get_fdlist(void)
{
  return nxsched_get_fdlist_from_tcb(this_task());
}

import argparse

import os

					type=int,
					metavar = '1,2,4',
					nargs='?',

					metavar='file',
					help='Output file name. E.g. my_font_20.c')
parser.add_argument('--compressed', action='store_true',
